problem:
Consider the differential equation $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}={x}^{2}-3x$ and its slope field. Which of the following statements are true?

- At every point along the line $x=2,$  the slope field has a negative slope
- At every point along the line $x=0,$  the slope field is horizontal
- At every point along the line $y=1,$ the slope of the slope field does not vary
